subclassfeature:flurry of healing and ha.name: Flurry of Healing and Harm
subclassfeature:flurry of healing and ha.subtitle: Monk (Warrior of Mercy) 11
entries: When you use Flurry of Blows, you can replace each of the Unarmed Strikes with a use of Hand of Healing without expending Focus Points for the healing.

In addition, when you make an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} with Flurry of Blows and deal damage, you can use Hand of Harm with that strike without expending a Focus Point for Hand of Harm. You can still use Hand of Harm only once per turn.
You can use these benefits a total number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassfeature:focused conjuration|wiza.name: Focused Conjuration
subclassfeature:focused conjuration|wiza.subtitle: Wizard (Conjurer) 10
entries: Taking damage can't break your {@status Concentration|XPHB} on {@filter Conjuration spells|spells|school=C}.

subclassfeature:focused strike|monk|myst.name: Focused Strike
subclassfeature:focused strike|monk|myst.subtitle: Monk (Warrior of the Mystic Arts) 11
entries: When you use your Stunning Strike, whether the target succeeds or fails on the saving throw, the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on saving throws against your spells until the start of your next turn.

subclassfeature:forge domain|cleric|forg.name: Forge Domain
subclassfeature:forge domain|cleric|forg.subtitle: Cleric (Forge Domain) 1
entries: The gods of the forge are patrons of artisans who work with metal, from a humble blacksmith who keeps a village in horseshoes and plow blades to the mighty elf artisan whose diamond-tipped arrows of mithral have felled demon lords. The gods of the forge teach that, with patience and hard work, even the most intractable metal can be transformed from a lump of ore to a beautifully wrought object. Clerics of these deities search for objects lost to the forces of darkness, liberate mines overrun by orcs, and uncover rare and wondrous materials necessary to create potent magic items. Followers of these gods take great pride in their work, and they are willing to craft and use heavy armor and powerful weapons to protect them. Deities of this domain include {@deity Gond}, {@deity Reorx|Dragonlance}, {@deity Onatar|Eberron}, {@deity Moradin|Nonhuman}, {@deity Hephaestus|Greek}, and {@deity Goibhniu|Celtic}.
At each indicated cleric level, add the listed spells to your spells prepared.

subclassfeature:forge domain|cleric|forg.name: Forge Domain
subclassfeature:forge domain|cleric|forg.subtitle: Cleric (Forge Domain) 3
entries: The gods of the forge are patrons of artisans who work with metal, from a humble blacksmith who keeps a village in horseshoes and plow blades to the mighty elf artisan whose diamond-tipped arrows of mithral have felled demon lords. The gods of the forge teach that, with patience and hard work, even the most intractable metal can be transformed from a lump of ore to a beautifully wrought object. Clerics of these deities search for objects lost to the forces of darkness, liberate mines overrun by orcs, and uncover rare and wondrous materials necessary to create potent magic items. Followers of these gods take great pride in their work, and they are willing to craft and use heavy armor and powerful weapons to protect them. Deities of this domain include {@deity Gond}, {@deity Reorx|Dragonlance}, {@deity Onatar|Eberron}, {@deity Moradin|Nonhuman}, {@deity Hephaestus|Greek}, and {@deity Goibhniu|Celtic}.
At each indicated cleric level, add the listed spells to your spells prepared.

subclassfeature:form of dread|warlock|un.name: Form of Dread
subclassfeature:form of dread|warlock|un.subtitle: Warlock (Undead Patron) 3
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you transform into an avatar of your patron's dreadful power, gaining the benefits below for 1 minute, until you have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition, or until you end the form (no action required). You can transform a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Facsimile of Life
entries: You gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 1d10} plus your Warlock level.

entries.name: Fearless Form
entries: You have Immunity to the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition. If you are Frightened when you transform, the condition immediately ends for you.

entries.name: Frightful Avatar
entries: Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can force it to make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, the target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the end of your next turn.

subclassfeature:form of the beast|barbar.name: Form of the Beast
subclassfeature:form of the beast|barbar.subtitle: Barbarian (Path of the Beast) 3
entries: {@i 3rd-level Path of the Beast feature}

When you enter your rage, you can transform, revealing the bestial power within you. Until the rage ends, you manifest a natural weapon. It counts as a simple melee weapon for you, and you add your Strength modifier to the attack and damage rolls when you attack with it, as normal.
You choose the weapon's form each time you rage:

items.name: Bite
items.entry: Your mouth transforms into a bestial muzzle or great mandibles (your choice). It deals {@damage 1d8} piercing damage on a hit. Once on each of your turns when you damage a creature with this bite, you regain a number of hit points equal to your proficiency bonus, provided you have less than half your hit points when you hit.

items.name: Claws
items.entry: Each of your hands transforms into a claw, which you can use as a weapon if it's empty. It deals {@damage 1d6} slashing damage on a hit. Once on each of your turns when you attack with a claw using the {@action Attack} action, you can make one additional claw attack as part of the same action.

items.name: Tail
items.entry: You grow a lashing, spiny tail, which deals {@damage 1d8} piercing damage on a hit and has the reach property. If a creature you can see within 10 feet of you hits you with an attack roll, you can use your reaction to swipe your tail and roll a {@dice d8}, applying a bonus to your AC equal to the number rolled, potentially causing the attack to miss you.

subclassfeature:forms of your astral sel.name: Forms of Your Astral Self
subclassfeature:forms of your astral sel.subtitle: Monk (Way of the Astral Self) 3
entries: The astral self is a translucent embodiment of the monk's soul. As a result, an astral self can reflect aspects of a monk's background, ideals, flaws, and bonds, and an astral self doesn't necessarily look anything like the monk. For example, the astral self of a lanky human might be reminiscent of a minotaur-the strength of which the monk feels within. Similarly, an orc monk might manifest gossamer arms and a delicate visage, representing the gentle beauty of the orc's soul. Each astral self is unique, and some of the monks of this monastic tradition are known more for the appearance of their astral self than for their physical appearance.

When choosing this path, consider the quirks that define your monk. Are you obsessed with something? Are you driven by justice or a selfish desire? Any of these motivations could manifest in the form of your astral self.

subclassfeature:fortified position|artif.name: Fortified Position
subclassfeature:fortified position|artif.subtitle: Artificer (Artillerist) 15
entries: You're a master at forming well-defended emplacements using your {@object Eldritch Cannon|EFA}. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Double Firepower
entries: You can now have two cannons at the same time, and you can create two with the same {@action Magic|XPHB} action. (If you expend a spell slot to create the first cannon, you must expend another spell slot to create the second.) You can activate both of them with the same {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, ordering them to use the same activation option or different ones. You can't create a third cannon while you have two.

entries.name: Shimmering Field Projection
entries: You and your allies have {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Half Cover} while within 10 feet of your {@object Eldritch Cannon|EFA}.

subclassfeature:fortifying soul|ranger|w.name: Fortifying Soul
subclassfeature:fortifying soul|ranger|w.subtitle: Ranger (Winter Walker) 7
entries: Your experience surviving harrowing environments allows you to bolster your allies in addition to yourself. As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, choose a number of creatures you can see equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of one). Each chosen creature regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 1d10} plus your Ranger level and has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition for 1 hour.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassfeature:fortifying spell|cleric|.name: Fortifying Spell
subclassfeature:fortifying spell|cleric|.subtitle: Cleric (Arcana Domain) 3
entries: One target of the spell gains a number of {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 2d8} plus your Cleric level.

subclassfeature:frenzy|barbarian|berserk.name: Frenzy
subclassfeature:frenzy|barbarian|berserk.subtitle: Barbarian (Path of the Berserker) 3
entries: If you use Reckless Attack while your Rage is active, you deal extra damage to the first target you hit on your turn with a Strength-based attack. To determine the extra damage, roll a number of d6s equal to your Rage Damage bonus, and add them together. The damage has the same type as the weapon or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} used for the attack.

subclassfeature:frigid explorer|ranger|w.name: Frigid Explorer
subclassfeature:frigid explorer|ranger|w.subtitle: Ranger (Winter Walker) 3
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Biting Cold
entries: Damage from your weapon attacks, Ranger spells, and Ranger features ignores {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Cold damage.

entries.name: Frost Resistance
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Cold damage.

entries.name: Polar Strikes
entries: When you hit a creature with an attack roll using a weapon, you can deal an extra {@damage 1d4} Cold damage to the target, which can take this extra damage only once per turn. When you reach Ranger level 11, this extra damage increases to {@damage 1d6}.

subclassfeature:frozen haunt|ranger|wint.name: Frozen Haunt
subclassfeature:frozen haunt|ranger|wint.subtitle: Ranger (Winter Walker) 15
entries: When you cast {@spell Hunter's Mark|XPHB}, you can adopt a ghostly, snowy form. This form lasts until the spell ends, and while you are in this form, you gain the following benefits. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} unless you expend a level 4+ spell slot (no action required).

entries.name: Frozen Soul
entries: You have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Cold damage. When you first adopt this form and at the start of each of your subsequent turns, each creature of your choice in a 15-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you takes {@damage 2d4} Cold damage.

entries.name: Partially Incorporeal
entries: You have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, {@condition Prone|XPHB}, and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions. You can move through creatures and objects as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}, but you take {@damage 1d10} Force damage if you end your turn inside a creature or an object. If the form ends while you are inside a creature or an object, you are shunted to the nearest unoccupied space.

subclassfeature:full of stars|druid|star.name: Full of Stars
subclassfeature:full of stars|druid|star.subtitle: Druid (Circle of the Stars) 14
entries: While in your Starry Form, you become partially incorporeal, giving you {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

subclassfeature:fungal body|druid|spores.name: Fungal Body
subclassfeature:fungal body|druid|spores.subtitle: Druid (Circle of Spores) 14
entries: At 14th level, the fungal spores in your body alter you: you can't be {@condition blinded}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition frightened}, or {@condition poisoned}, and any critical hit against you counts as a normal hit instead, unless you're {@condition incapacitated}.

subclassfeature:fungal infestation|druid.name: Fungal Infestation
subclassfeature:fungal infestation|druid.subtitle: Druid (Circle of Spores) 6
entries: At 6th level, your spores gain the ability to infest a corpse and animate it. If a beast or a humanoid that is Small or Medium dies within 10 feet of you, you can use your reaction to animate it, causing it to stand up immediately with 1 hit point. The creature uses the {@creature zombie} stat block in the {@book Monster Manual|MM}. It remains animate for 1 hour, after which time it collapses and dies.
In combat, the zombie's turn comes immediately after yours. It obeys your mental commands, and the only action it can take is the {@action Attack} action, making one melee attack.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses of it when you finish a long rest.

subclassfeature:gathered swarm|ranger|sw.name: Gathered Swarm
subclassfeature:gathered swarm|ranger|sw.subtitle: Ranger (Swarmkeeper) 3
entries: {@i 3rd-level Swarmkeeper feature}

A swarm of intangible nature spirits has bonded itself to you and can assist you in battle. While you're alive, the swarm remains in your space, crawling on you or flying and skittering around you within your space. You determine its appearance, or you generate its appearance by rolling on the Swarm Appearance table.
Once on each of your turns, you can cause the swarm to assist you in one of the following ways, immediately after you hit a creature with an attack:

items: The attack's target takes {@damage 1d6} piercing damage from the swarm.
The attack's target must succeed on a Strength saving throw against your spell save DC or be moved by the swarm up to 15 feet horizontally in a direction of your choice.
You are moved by the swarm 5 feet horizontally in a direction of your choice.

entries.name: It's Your Swarm
entries: A Swarmkeeper's swarm and spells are reflections of the character's bond with nature spirits. Take the opportunity to describe the swarm and the ranger's magic in play. For example, when your ranger casts gaseous form, they might appear to melt into the swarm, instead of a cloud of mist, or the {@spell arcane eye} spell could create an extension of your swarm that spies for you. Such descriptions don't change the effects of spells, but they are an exciting opportunity to explore your character's narrative through their class abilities. For more guidance on customizing spells, see the "Personalizing Spells" section in chapter 3.

Also, remember that the swarm's appearance is yours to customize, and don't feel confined to a single appearance. Perhaps the spirits' look changes with the ranger's mood or with the seasons. You decide!

subclassfeature:genie spells|paladin|nob.name: Genie Spells
subclassfeature:genie spells|paladin|nob.subtitle: Paladin (Oath of the Noble Genies) 3
entries: When you reach a Paladin level specified in the Genie Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

subclassfeature:genie's splendor|paladin.name: Genie's Splendor
subclassfeature:genie's splendor|paladin.subtitle: Paladin (Oath of the Noble Genies) 3
entries: When you aren't wearing any armor, your base {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} equals 10 plus your Dexterity and Charisma modifiers. You can use a Shield and still gain this benefit.
You also gain proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: {@skill Acrobatics|XPHB}, {@skill Intimidation|XPHB}, {@skill Performance|XPHB}, or {@skill Persuasion|XPHB}.

subclassfeature:genie's vessel|warlock|g.name: Genie's Vessel
subclassfeature:genie's vessel|warlock|g.subtitle: Warlock (The Genie) 1
entries: {@i 1st-level Genie feature}

Your patron gifts you a magical vessel that grants you a measure of the genie's power. The vessel is a Tiny object, and you can use it as a spellcasting focus for your warlock spells. You decide what the object is, or you can determine what it is randomly by rolling on the Genie's Vessel table.
While you are touching the vessel, you can use it in the following ways:
The vessel's AC equals your spell save DC. Its hit points equal your warlock level plus your proficiency bonus, and it is immune to poison and psychic damage.

If the vessel is destroyed or you lose it, you can perform a 1-hour ceremony to receive a replacement from your patron. This ceremony can be performed during a short or long rest, and the previous vessel is destroyed if it still exists. The vessel vanishes in a flare of elemental power when you die.

subclassfeature:genie's wrath|warlock|ge.name: Genie's Wrath
subclassfeature:genie's wrath|warlock|ge.subtitle: Warlock (The Genie) 1
entries: Once during each of your turns when you hit with an attack roll, you can deal extra damage to the target equal to your proficiency bonus. The type of this damage is determined by your patron: bludgeoning (dao), thunder (djinni), fire (efreeti), or cold (marid).

subclassfeature:ghost walk|rogue|phantom.name: Ghost Walk
subclassfeature:ghost walk|rogue|phantom.subtitle: Rogue (Phantom) 13
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you assume a spectral form, gaining the benefits below for 10 minutes or until you end them (no action required). Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} unless you destroy one of your soul trinkets from Tokens of the Departed (no action required) to restore your use of it.

entries.name: Flight
entries: You gain a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} of 10 feet and can hover.

entries.name: Hazy Form
entries: Attack rolls have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} against you.

entries.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: You can move through creatures and objects as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}, but you take {@damage 1d10} Force damage if you end your turn inside a creature or an object.

subclassfeature:giant power|barbarian|gi.name: Giant Power
subclassfeature:giant power|barbarian|gi.subtitle: Barbarian (Path of the Giant) 3
entries: {@i 3rd-Level Path of the Giant Feature}

When you choose this path, you learn to speak, read, and write Giant or one other language of your choice if you already know Giant. Additionally, you learn a cantrip of your choice: either {@spell druidcraft} or {@spell thaumaturgy}. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

subclassfeature:giant's havoc|barbarian|.name: Giant's Havoc
subclassfeature:giant's havoc|barbarian|.subtitle: Barbarian (Path of the Giant) 3
entries: {@i 3rd-Level Path of the Giant Feature}
Your rages pull strength from the primal might of giants, transforming you into a hulking force of destruction. While raging, you gain the following benefits:

items.name: Crushing Throw
items.entry: When you make a successful ranged attack with a thrown weapon using Strength, you can add your Rage Damage bonus to the attack's damage roll.

items.name: Giant Stature
items.entry: Your reach increases by 5 feet, and if you are smaller than Large, you become Large, along with anything you are wearing. If there isn't enough room for you to increase your size, your size doesn't change.

subclassfeature:giant's might|fighter|ru.name: Giant's Might
subclassfeature:giant's might|fighter|ru.subtitle: Fighter (Rune Knight) 3
entries: {@i 3rd-level Rune Knight feature}
You have learned how to imbue yourself with the might of giants. As a bonus action, you magically gain the following benefits, which last for 1 minute:

items: If you are smaller than Large, you become Large, along with anything you are wearing. If you lack the room to become Large, your size doesn't change.
You have advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws.
Once on each of your turns, one of your attacks with a weapon or an unarmed strike can deal an extra {@damage 1d6} damage to a target on a hit.

entries: You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses of it when you finish a long rest.

subclassfeature:gift of the sea|warlock|.name: Gift of the Sea
subclassfeature:gift of the sea|warlock|.subtitle: Warlock (The Fathomless) 1
entries: {@i 1st-level Fathomless feature}
You gain a swimming speed of 40 feet, and you can breathe underwater.

subclassfeature:gloom stalker|ranger|glo.name: Gloom Stalker
subclassfeature:gloom stalker|ranger|glo.subtitle: Ranger (Gloom Stalker) 3
entries: {@i Draw on Shadow Magic to Fight Your Foes}
Gloom Stalkers are at home in the darkest places, wielding magic drawn from the Shadowfell to combat enemies that lurk in darkness.

subclassfeature:gloom stalker spells|ran.name: Gloom Stalker Spells
subclassfeature:gloom stalker spells|ran.subtitle: Ranger (Gloom Stalker) 3
entries: When you reach a Ranger level specified in the Gloom Stalker Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

subclassfeature:glorious defense|paladin.name: Glorious Defense
subclassfeature:glorious defense|paladin.subtitle: Paladin (Oath of Glory) 15
entries: You can turn defense into a sudden strike. When you or another creature you can see within 10 feet of you is hit by an attack roll, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to grant a bonus to the target's AC against that attack, potentially causing it to miss. The bonus equals your Charisma modifier (minimum of +1). If the attack misses, you can make one attack with a weapon against the attacker as part of this {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} if the attacker is within your weapon's range.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassfeature:grasping tentacles|warlo.name: Grasping Tentacles
subclassfeature:grasping tentacles|warlo.subtitle: Warlock (The Fathomless) 10
entries: {@i 10th-level Fathomless feature}

You learn the spell {@spell Evard's black tentacles}. It counts as a warlock spell for you, but it doesn't count against the number of spells you know. You can also cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest.

Whenever you cast this spell, your patron's magic bolsters you, granting you a number of temporary hit points equal to your warlock level. Moreover, damage can't break your {@status concentration} on this spell.

subclassfeature:grave domain|cleric|grav.name: Grave Domain
subclassfeature:grave domain|cleric|grav.subtitle: Cleric (Grave Domain) 3
entries: {@i Embody Deific Forces of Death}

The Grave Domain concerns itself with the boundary between life and death. To those who tap into this domain's power, death is a natural and inevitable part of the multiverse. Such Clerics seek to destroy undead and shepherd spirits.
The magic of this domain also allows these Clerics to stave off death for a time. But this is merely a delay of death, not a denial of it, for the grave will always claim its due.

subclassfeature:grave domain spells|cler.name: Grave Domain Spells
subclassfeature:grave domain spells|cler.subtitle: Cleric (Grave Domain) 3
entries: Your connection to this divine domain ensures you always have certain spells ready. When you reach a Cleric level specified in the Grave Domain Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

entries.caption: Grave Domain Spells
rows: {@spell Detect Evil and Good|XPHB}, {@spell False Life|XPHB}, {@spell Gentle Repose|XPHB}, {@spell Ray of Enfeeblement|XPHB}, {@spell Spare the Dying|XPHB}
{@spell Dispel Evil and Good|XPHB}, {@spell Raise Dead|XPHB}

subclassfeature:grave power|wizard|necro.name: Grave Power
subclassfeature:grave power|wizard|necro.subtitle: Wizard (Necromancer) 6
entries: You have discovered more necromantic insights and inscribed them in your spellbook. While holding your spellbook, you gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Grave Resilience
entries: When you use Arcane Recovery, your {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level, if any, decreases by 1.

entries.name: Overwhelming Necrosis
entries: Damage from your Wizard spells and Wizard features ignores {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Necrotic damage.

subclassfeature:grave touched|warlock|un.name: Grave Touched
subclassfeature:grave touched|warlock|un.subtitle: Warlock (Undead Patron) 6
entries: Your patron's powers have a profound effect on your body and magic, granting you the following benefits.

entries.name: Arcane Necrosis
entries: Necrotic damage from your attacks, Warlock spells, and Warlock features ignores {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Necrotic damage. Once per turn when you cast a spell that deals damage, you can change that spell's damage type to Necrotic.

entries.name: Dreaded Necrosis
entries: When you hit a creature with an attack roll and deal Necrotic damage while using your Form of Dread, you can roll one additional damage die when determining the Necrotic damage the target takes. You can use this benefit only once per turn.

entries.name: Undead Endurance
entries: You don't gain {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} levels from {@hazard dehydration|XPHB}, {@hazard malnutrition|XPHB}, or {@hazard suffocation|XPHB}. In addition, you don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep.

subclassfeature:graviturgy magic|wizard|.name: Graviturgy Magic
subclassfeature:graviturgy magic|wizard|.subtitle: Wizard (Graviturgy Magic) 2
entries: Understanding and mastering the forces that draw bodies of matter together or drive them apart, the students of the Graviturgy arcane tradition learn to further bend and manipulate the violent energy of gravity to their benefit, and the terrible detriment of their enemies.
{@note Note: This subclass has access to {@book Dunamancy Spells|EGW|5|Dunamancy Spells}}.

subclassfeature:graviturgy magic|wizard|.name: Graviturgy Magic
subclassfeature:graviturgy magic|wizard|.subtitle: Wizard (Graviturgy Magic) 3
entries: Understanding and mastering the forces that draw bodies of matter together or drive them apart, the students of the Graviturgy arcane tradition learn to further bend and manipulate the violent energy of gravity to their benefit, and the terrible detriment of their enemies.
{@note Note: This subclass has access to {@book Dunamancy Spells|EGW|5|Dunamancy Spells}}.

subclassfeature:gravity well|wizard|grav.name: Gravity Well
subclassfeature:gravity well|wizard|grav.subtitle: Wizard (Graviturgy Magic) 6
entries: {@i 6th-level Graviturgy Magic feature}

You've learned how to manipulate gravity around a living being: whenever you cast a spell on a creature, you can move the target 5 feet to an unoccupied space of your choice if the target is willing to move, the spell hits it with an attack, or it fails a saving throw against the spell.

subclassfeature:great old one patron|war.name: Great Old One Patron
subclassfeature:great old one patron|war.subtitle: Warlock (Great Old One Patron) 3
entries: {@i Unearth Forbidden Lore of Ineffable Beings}

When you choose this subclass, you might bind yourself to an unspeakable being from the Far Realm or an elder god—a being such as Tharizdun, the Chained God; Zargon, the Returner; Hadar, the Dark Hunger; or Great Cthulhu. Or you might invoke several entities without yoking yourself to one. The motives of these beings are incomprehensible, and the Great Old One might be indifferent to your existence. But the secrets you've learned nevertheless allow you to draw strange magic from it.

entries.subclassFeature: Great Old One Spells|Warlock|XPHB|Great Old One|XPHB|3

subclassfeature:great old one spells|war.name: Great Old One Spells
subclassfeature:great old one spells|war.subtitle: Warlock (Great Old One Patron) 3
entries: The magic of your patron ensures you always have certain spells ready; when you reach a Warlock level specified in the Great Old One Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

entries.caption: Great Old One Spells
rows: {@spell Detect Thoughts|XPHB}, {@spell Dissonant Whispers|XPHB}, {@spell Phantasmal Force|XPHB}, {@spell Tasha's Hideous Laughter|XPHB}

subclassfeature:great stature|fighter|ru.name: Great Stature
subclassfeature:great stature|fighter|ru.subtitle: Fighter (Rune Knight) 10
entries: {@i 10th-level Rune Knight feature}
The magic of your runes permanently alters you. When you gain this feature, roll {@dice 3d4}. You grow a number of inches in height equal to the roll.
Moreover, the extra damage you deal with your Giant's Might feature increases to {@damage 1d8}.

subclassfeature:greater portent|wizard|d.name: Greater Portent
subclassfeature:greater portent|wizard|d.subtitle: Wizard (Diviner) 14
entries: The visions in your dreams intensify and paint a more accurate picture in your mind of what is to come. Roll three d20s for your Portent feature rather than two.

subclassfeature:group recovery|fighter|b.name: Group Recovery
subclassfeature:group recovery|fighter|b.subtitle: Fighter (Banneret) 3
entries: When you use your Second Wind to regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, you can choose a number of allies within a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from yourself, up to a number of allies equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one). Each of those allies regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 1d4} plus your Fighter level. Once you use this ability, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassfeature:guarded mind|fighter|psi.name: Guarded Mind
subclassfeature:guarded mind|fighter|psi.subtitle: Fighter (Psi Warrior) 10
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Psychic damage. Moreover, if you start your turn with the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} or {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition, you can expend a Psionic Energy Die (no action required) and end every effect on yourself giving you those conditions.

subclassfeature:guardian|artificer|armor.name: Guardian
subclassfeature:guardian|artificer|armor.subtitle: Artificer (Armorer) 3
entries: You design your armor to be in the front line of conflict. It has the following features:

entries.name: Thunder Pulse
entries: You can discharge concussive blasts with strikes from your armor. The pulse counts as a Simple Melee weapon and deals {@damage 1d8} Thunder damage on a hit. A creature hit by the pulse has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against targets other than you until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Defensive Field
entries: While {@status Bloodied|XPHB}, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your Artificer level. You lose these {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} if you doff the armor.

subclassfeature:guardian coil|warlock|fa.name: Guardian Coil
subclassfeature:guardian coil|warlock|fa.subtitle: Warlock (The Fathomless) 6
entries: {@i 6th-level Fathomless feature}

Your Tentacle of the Deeps can defend you and others, interposing itself between them and harm. When you or a creature you can see takes damage while within 10 feet of the tentacle, you can use your reaction to choose one of those creatures and reduce the damage to that creature by {@dice 1d8}. When you reach 10th level in this class, the damage reduced by the tentacle increases to {@dice 2d8}.

subclassfeature:guardian spirit|druid|sh.name: Guardian Spirit
subclassfeature:guardian spirit|druid|sh.subtitle: Druid (Circle of the Shepherd) 10
entries: Beginning at 10th level, your Spirit Totem safeguards the beasts and fey that you call forth with your magic. When a beast or fey that you summoned or created with a spell ends its turn in your Spirit Totem aura, that creature regains a number of hit points equal to half your druid level.

subclassfeature:guided precision|artific.name: Guided Precision
subclassfeature:guided precision|artific.subtitle: Artificer (Cartographer) 5
entries: Once per turn, whenever you cast a spell from your Cartographer Spells list or hit a creature affected by your {@spell Faerie Fire|XPHB} with an attack roll, you can add your Intelligence modifier to one damage roll of the spell or attack.
In addition, taking damage can't cause you to lose {@status Concentration|XPHB} on {@spell Faerie Fire|XPHB}.

subclassfeature:guided strike|cleric|war.name: Guided Strike
subclassfeature:guided strike|cleric|war.subtitle: Cleric (War Domain) 3
entries: When you or a creature within 30 feet of you misses with an attack roll, you can expend one use of your Channel Divinity and give that roll a +10 bonus, potentially causing it to hit. When you use this feature to benefit another creature's attack roll, you must take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to do so.

subclassfeature:guided strike|paladin|co.name: Guided Strike
subclassfeature:guided strike|paladin|co.subtitle: Paladin (Oath of Conquest) 3
entries: You can use your Channel Divinity to strike with supernatural accuracy. When you make an attack roll, you can use your Channel Divinity to gain a +10 bonus to the roll. You make this choice after you see the roll, but before the DM says whether the attack hits or misses.

subclassfeature:halo of spores|druid|spo.name: Halo of Spores
subclassfeature:halo of spores|druid|spo.subtitle: Druid (Circle of Spores) 2
entries: Starting at 2nd level, you are surrounded by invisible, necrotic spores that are harmless until you unleash them on a creature nearby. When a creature you can see moves into a space within 10 feet of you or starts its turn there, you can use your reaction to deal {@damage 1d4} necrotic damage to that creature unless it succeeds on a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC. The necrotic damage increases to {@damage 1d6} at 6th level, {@damage 1d8} at 10th level, and {@damage 1d10} at 14th level.

subclassfeature:hand of harm|monk|mercy|.name: Hand of Harm
subclassfeature:hand of harm|monk|mercy|.subtitle: Monk (Warrior of Mercy) 3
entries: Once per turn when you hit a creature with an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} and deal damage, you can expend 1 Focus Point to deal extra Necrotic damage equal to one roll of your Martial Arts die plus your Wisdom modifier.

subclassfeature:hand of healing|monk|mer.name: Hand of Healing
subclassfeature:hand of healing|monk|mer.subtitle: Monk (Warrior of Mercy) 3
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can expend 1 Focus Point to touch a creature and restore a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to a roll of your Martial Arts die plus your Wisdom modifier. When you use your Flurry of Blows, you can replace one of the Unarmed Strikes with a use of this feature without expending a Focus Point for the healing.

subclassfeature:hand of ultimate mercy|m.name: Hand of Ultimate Mercy
subclassfeature:hand of ultimate mercy|m.subtitle: Monk (Warrior of Mercy) 17
entries: Your mastery of life energy opens the door to the ultimate mercy. As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can touch the corpse of a creature that died within the past 24 hours and expend 5 Focus Points. The creature then returns to life with a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 4d10} plus your Wisdom modifier. If the creature died with any of the following conditions, the creature revives with the conditions removed: {@condition Blinded|XPHB}, {@condition Deafened|XPHB}, {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB}, {@condition Poisoned|XPHB}, and {@condition Stunned|XPHB}.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassfeature:harvest undead|wizard|ne.name: Harvest Undead
subclassfeature:harvest undead|wizard|ne.subtitle: Wizard (Necromancer) 10
entries: You have learned more secrets about the nuances of life and death. Immediately after you become {@status Bloodied|XPHB} but aren't reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} from taking damage, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to reduce an Undead creature under your control that you can see to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. You then immediately regain a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your Wizard level.

subclassfeature:healing light|warlock|ce.name: Healing Light
subclassfeature:healing light|warlock|ce.subtitle: Warlock (Celestial Patron) 3
entries: You gain the ability to channel celestial energy to heal wounds. You have a pool of d6s to fuel this healing. The number of dice in the pool equals 1 plus your Warlock level.

As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can heal yourself or one creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself, expending dice from the pool. The maximum number of dice you can expend at once equals your Charisma modifier (minimum of one die). Roll the dice you expend, and restore a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the roll's total. Your pool regains all expended dice when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassfeature:heart of fire|sorcerer|p.name: Heart of Fire
subclassfeature:heart of fire|sorcerer|p.subtitle: Sorcerer (Pyromancer (PSK)) 1
entries: At 1st level, whenever you start casting a spell of 1st level or higher that deals fire damage, fiery magic erupts from you. This eruption causes creatures of your choice that you can see within 10 feet of you to take fire damage equal to half your sorcerer level (minimum of 1).

subclassfeature:heart of the storm|sorce.name: Heart of the Storm
subclassfeature:heart of the storm|sorce.subtitle: Sorcerer (Storm Sorcery) 6
entries: At 6th level, you gain resistance to lightning and thunder damage. In addition, whenever you start casting a spell of 1st level or higher that deals lightning or thunder damage, stormy magic erupts from you. This eruption causes creatures of your choice that you can see within 10 feet of you to take lightning or thunder damage (choose each time this ability activates) equal to half your sorcerer level.

subclassfeature:hearth of moonlight and.name: Hearth of Moonlight and Shadow
subclassfeature:hearth of moonlight and.subtitle: Druid (Circle of Dreams) 6
entries: At 6th level, home can be wherever you are. During a short or long rest, you can invoke the shadowy power of the Gloaming Court to help guard your respite. At the start of the rest, you touch a point in space, and an invisible, 30-foot-radius sphere of magic appears, centered on that point. {@quickref Cover||3||Total cover} blocks the sphere.

While within the sphere, you and your allies gain a +5 bonus to Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) and Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks, and any light from open flames in the sphere (a campfire, torches, or the like) isn't visible outside it.
The sphere vanishes at the end of the rest or when you leave the sphere.

subclassfeature:heroic warrior|fighter|c.name: Heroic Warrior
subclassfeature:heroic warrior|fighter|c.subtitle: Fighter (Champion) 10
entries: The thrill of battle drives you toward victory. During combat, you can give yourself {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB} whenever you start your turn without it.

subclassfeature:hex warrior|warlock|hexb.name: Hex Warrior
subclassfeature:hex warrior|warlock|hexb.subtitle: Warlock (The Hexblade) 1
entries: At 1st level, you acquire the training necessary to effectively arm yourself for battle. You gain proficiency with medium armor, shields, and martial weapons.

The influence of your patron also allows you to mystically channel your will through a particular weapon. Whenever you finish a long rest, you can touch one weapon that you are proficient with and that lacks the two-handed property. When you attack with that weapon, you can use your Charisma modifier, instead of Strength or Dexterity, for the attack and damage rolls. This benefit lasts until you finish a long rest. If you later gain the Pact of the Blade feature, this benefit extends to every pact weapon you conjure with that feature, no matter the weapon's type.

subclassfeature:hexblade's curse|warlock.name: Hexblade's Curse
subclassfeature:hexblade's curse|warlock.subtitle: Warlock (The Hexblade) 1
entries: Starting at 1st level, you gain the ability to place a baleful curse on someone. As a bonus action, choose one creature you can see within 30 feet of you. The target is cursed for 1 minute. The curse ends early if the target dies, you die, or you are {@condition incapacitated}. Until the curse ends, you gain the following benefits:

items: You gain a bonus to damage rolls against the cursed target. The bonus equals your proficiency bonus.
Any attack roll you make against the cursed target is a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20 on the {@dice d20}.
If the cursed target dies, you regain hit points equal to your warlock level + your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1 hit point).

entries: You can't use this feature again until you finish a short or long rest.

subclassfeature:hidden paths|druid|dream.name: Hidden Paths
subclassfeature:hidden paths|druid|dream.subtitle: Druid (Circle of Dreams) 10
entries: Starting at 10th level, you can use the hidden, magical pathways that some fey use to traverse space in the blink of an eye. As a bonus action on your turn, you can teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. Alternatively, you can use your action to teleport one willing creature you touch up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses of it when you finish a long rest.

subclassfeature:hold the line|fighter|ca.name: Hold the Line
subclassfeature:hold the line|fighter|ca.subtitle: Fighter (Cavalier) 10
entries: At 10th level, you become a master of locking down your enemies. Creatures provoke an opportunity attack from you when they move 5 feet or more while within your reach, and if you hit a creature with an opportunity attack, the target's speed is reduced to 0 until the end of the current turn.

subclassfeature:hollow warden|ranger|hol.name: Hollow Warden
subclassfeature:hollow warden|ranger|hol.subtitle: Ranger (Hollow Warden) 3
entries: {@i Draw on the Might of Ancient Wild Terrors}

Legends tell that the most ancient and bloodthirsty terrors lurk deep within the old places of the earth. Hollow Wardens venerate and draw power from such beings, transforming themselves into merciless and monstrous guardians that stalk jagged coastlines, steep mountain crags, and other dark and wild places.

subclassfeature:hollow warden spells|ran.name: Hollow Warden Spells
subclassfeature:hollow warden spells|ran.subtitle: Ranger (Hollow Warden) 3
entries: When you reach a Ranger level specified in the Hollow Warden Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spell prepared.

subclassfeature:holy nimbus|paladin|devo.name: Holy Nimbus
subclassfeature:holy nimbus|paladin|devo.subtitle: Paladin (Oath of Devotion) 20
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can imbue your Aura of Protection with holy power, granting the benefits below for 10 minutes or until you end them (no action required). Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also restore your use of it by expending a level 5 spell slot (no action required).

entries.name: Holy Ward
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on any saving throw you are forced to make by a Fiend or an Undead.

entries.name: Radiant Damage
entries: Whenever an enemy starts its turn in the aura, that creature takes Radiant damage equal to your Charisma modifier plus your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}.

entries.name: Sunlight
entries: The aura is filled with {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} that is sunlight.

subclassfeature:homing strikes|rogue|sou.name: Homing Strikes
subclassfeature:homing strikes|rogue|sou.subtitle: Rogue (Soulknife) 9
entries: If you make an attack roll with your {@item Psychic Blade|XPHB} and miss the target, you can roll one Psionic Energy Die and add the number rolled to the attack roll. If this causes the attack to hit, the die is expended.

subclassfeature:honed spellfire|sorcerer.name: Honed Spellfire
subclassfeature:honed spellfire|sorcerer.subtitle: Sorcerer (Spellfire Sorcery) 14
entries: Your {@subclassFeature Spellfire Burst|Sorcerer|XPHB|Spellfire|FRHoF|3|FRHoF} improves. You add your {@class Sorcerer|XPHB} level to the {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} gained from {@subclassFeature Bolstering Flames|Sorcerer|XPHB|Spellfire|FRHoF|3|FRHoF}, and the damage of {@subclassFeature Radiant Fire|Sorcerer|XPHB|Spellfire|FRHoF|3|FRHoF} increases to {@damage 1d8}.

subclassfeature:horizon walker|ranger|ho.name: Horizon Walker
subclassfeature:horizon walker|ranger|ho.subtitle: Ranger (Horizon Walker) 3
entries: Horizon Walkers guard the world against threats that originate from other planes or that seek to ravage the mortal realm with otherworldly magic. They seek out planar portals and keep watch over them, venturing to the Inner Planes and the Outer Planes as needed to pursue their foes. These rangers are also friends to any forces in the multiverse—especially benevolent dragons, fey, and elementals—that work to preserve life and the order of the planes.

subclassfeature:horizon walker magic|ran.name: Horizon Walker Magic
subclassfeature:horizon walker magic|ran.subtitle: Ranger (Horizon Walker) 3
entries: Starting at 3rd level, you learn an additional spell when you reach certain levels in this class, as shown in the Horizon Walker Spells table. The spell counts as a ranger spell for you, but it doesn't count against the number of ranger spells you know.

subclassfeature:hour of reaping|monk|lon.name: Hour of Reaping
subclassfeature:hour of reaping|monk|lon.subtitle: Monk (Way of the Long Death) 6
entries: At 6th level, you gain the ability to unsettle or terrify those around you as an action, for your soul has been touched by the shadow of death. When you take this action, each creature within 30 feet of you that can see you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} of you until the end of your next turn.

subclassfeature:hungering might|ranger|h.name: Hungering Might
subclassfeature:hungering might|ranger|h.subtitle: Ranger (Hollow Warden) 7
entries: You gain a bonus to Constitution saving throws equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of +1).

In addition, once per turn when you hit a creature with an attack roll while you are transformed using Wrath of the Wild, you regain a number of Hit Points equal to {@dice 1d10} plus your Wisdom modifier, provided you are {@status Bloodied|XPHB} when you hit.

subclassfeature:hunter|ranger|hunter|3|x.name: Hunter
subclassfeature:hunter|ranger|hunter|3|x.subtitle: Ranger (Hunter) 3
entries: {@i Protect Nature and People from Destruction}
You stalk prey in the wilds and elsewhere, using your abilities as a Hunter to protect nature and people everywhere from forces that would destroy them.

subclassfeature:hunter's lore|ranger|hun.name: Hunter's Lore
subclassfeature:hunter's lore|ranger|hun.subtitle: Ranger (Hunter) 3
entries: You can call on the forces of nature to reveal certain strengths and weaknesses of your prey. While a creature is marked by your Hunter's Mark, you know whether that creature has any Immunities, Resistances, or Vulnerabilities, and if the creature has any, you know what they are.

subclassfeature:hunter's prey|ranger|hun.name: Hunter's Prey
subclassfeature:hunter's prey|ranger|hun.subtitle: Ranger (Hunter) 3
entries: You gain one of the following feature options of your choice. Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can replace the chosen option with the other one.

entries.name: Colossus Slayer
entries: Your tenacity can wear down even the most resilient foes. When you hit a creature with a weapon, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 1d8} damage to the target if it's missing any of its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. You can deal this extra damage only once per turn.

entries.name: Horde Breaker
entries: Once on each of your turns when you make an attack with a weapon, you can make another attack with the same weapon against a different creature that is within 5 feet of the original target, that is within the weapon's range, and that you haven't attacked this turn.

subclassfeature:hunter's rime|ranger|win.name: Hunter's Rime
subclassfeature:hunter's rime|ranger|win.subtitle: Ranger (Winter Walker) 3
entries: Ice rimes you and your prey, protecting you and slowing them. When you cast {@spell Hunter's Mark|XPHB}, you gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 1d10} plus your {@class Ranger|XPHB} level.
Additionally, while a creature is marked by your {@spell Hunter's Mark|XPHB}, it can't take the {@action Disengage|XPHB} action.

subclassfeature:hunter's sense|ranger|mo.name: Hunter's Sense
subclassfeature:hunter's sense|ranger|mo.subtitle: Ranger (Monster Slayer) 3
entries: At 3rd level, you gain the ability to peer at a creature and magically discern how best to hurt it. As an action, choose one creature you can see within 60 feet of you. You immediately learn whether the creature has any damage immunities, resistances, or vulnerabilities and what they are. If the creature is hidden from divination magic, you sense that it has no damage immunities, resistances, or vulnerabilities.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses of it when you finish a long rest.

subclassfeature:hurl through hell|warloc.name: Hurl Through Hell
subclassfeature:hurl through hell|warloc.subtitle: Warlock (Fiend Patron) 14
entries: Once per turn when you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can try to instantly transport the target through the Lower Planes. The target must succeed on a Charisma saving throw against your spell save DC, or the target disappears and hurtles through a nightmare landscape. The target takes {@damage 8d10} Psychic damage if it isn't a Fiend, and it has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition until the end of your next turn, when it returns to the space it previously occupied or the nearest unoccupied space.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} unless you expend a Pact Magic spell slot (no action required) to restore your use of it.

subclassfeature:hypnotic presence|wizard.name: Hypnotic Presence
subclassfeature:hypnotic presence|wizard.subtitle: Wizard (Enchanter) 3
entries: Your charming words and enchanting gaze can enthrall another creature. As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, choose one creature that you can see within 10 feet of yourself. If the target can see or hear you, it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or have the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition for 1 minute or until the target is more than 10 feet away from you, the target can neither see nor hear you, or the target takes damage. While {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition and a {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} of 0.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassfeature:illusion savant|wizard|i.name: Illusion Savant
subclassfeature:illusion savant|wizard|i.subtitle: Wizard (Illusionist) 3
entries: Choose two {@filter Wizard spells from the Illusion school|spells|level=0;1;2|class=Wizard|school=I}, each of which must be no higher than level 2, and add them to your spellbook for free.

In addition, whenever you gain access to a new level of spell slots in this class, you can add one Wizard spell from the Illusion school to your spellbook for free. The chosen spell must be of a level for which you have spell slots.

subclassfeature:illusionist|wizard|illus.name: Illusionist
subclassfeature:illusionist|wizard|illus.subtitle: Wizard (Illusionist) 3
entries: {@i Weave Subtle Spells of Deception}
You specialize in magic that dazzles the senses and tricks the mind, and the illusions you craft make the impossible seem real.

subclassfeature:illusory reality|wizard|.name: Illusory Reality
subclassfeature:illusory reality|wizard|.subtitle: Wizard (Illusionist) 14
entries: You have learned to weave shadow magic into your illusions to give them a semi-reality. When you cast an Illusion spell with a spell slot, you can choose one inanimate, nonmagical object that is part of the illusion and make that object real. You can do this on your turn as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} while the spell is ongoing. The object remains real for 1 minute, during which it can't deal damage or give any conditions. For example, you can create an illusion of a bridge over a chasm and then make it real and cross it.

subclassfeature:illusory self|wizard|ill.name: Illusory Self
subclassfeature:illusory self|wizard|ill.subtitle: Wizard (Illusionist) 10
entries: When a creature hits you with an attack roll, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to interpose an illusory duplicate of yourself between the attacker and yourself. The attack automatically misses you, then the illusion dissipates.

Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also restore your use of it by expending a level 2+ spell slot (no action required).

subclassfeature:implement of peace|cleri.name: Implement of Peace
subclassfeature:implement of peace|cleri.subtitle: Cleric (Peace Domain) 1
entries: {@i 1st-level Peace Domain feature}
You gain proficiency in the {@skill Insight}, {@skill Performance}, or {@skill Persuasion} skill (your choice).

subclassfeature:implements of mercy|monk.name: Implements of Mercy
subclassfeature:implements of mercy|monk.subtitle: Monk (Warrior of Mercy) 3
entries: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Insight|XPHB} and {@skill Medicine|XPHB} skills and proficiency with the {@item Herbalism Kit|XPHB}.

subclassfeature:improved armorer|artific.name: Improved Armorer
subclassfeature:improved armorer|artific.subtitle: Artificer (Armorer) 9
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Armor Replication
entries: You learn an additional plan for your Replicate Magic Item feature, and it must be in the Armor category. If you replace that plan, you must replace it with another Armor plan.
In addition, you can create an additional item with that feature, and the item must also be in the Armor category.

entries.name: Improved Arsenal
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with the special weapon of your Arcane Armor model.

subclassfeature:improved circle forms|dr.name: Improved Circle Forms
subclassfeature:improved circle forms|dr.subtitle: Druid (Circle of the Moon) 6
entries: While in a Wild Shape form, you gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Lunar Radiance
entries: Each of your attacks in a Wild Shape form can deal its normal damage type or Radiant damage. You make this choice each time you hit with those attacks.

entries.name: Increased Toughness
entries: You can add your Wisdom modifier to your Constitution saving throws.

subclassfeature:improved combat superior.name: Improved Combat Superiority
subclassfeature:improved combat superior.subtitle: Fighter (Battle Master) 10
entries: Your Superiority Die becomes a {@dice d10}.

subclassfeature:improved critical|fighte.name: Improved Critical
subclassfeature:improved critical|fighte.subtitle: Fighter (Champion) 3
entries: Your attack rolls with weapons and Unarmed Strikes can score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} on a roll of 19 or 20 on the {@dice d20}.

subclassfeature:improved defender|artifi.name: Improved Defender
subclassfeature:improved defender|artifi.subtitle: Artificer (Battle Smith) 15
entries: Your {@subclassFeature Arcane Jolt|Artificer|EFA|Battle Smith|EFA|9|EFA} and {@creature Steel Defender|EFA} have become more powerful, granting these benefits.

entries.name: Improved Jolt
entries: The extra damage and healing of your Arcane Jolt both increase to {@dice 4d6}.

entries.name: Improved Deflection
entries: Whenever your {@creature Steel Defender|EFA} uses its Deflect Attack, the attacker takes Force damage equal to {@damage 1d4} plus your Intelligence modifier.

subclassfeature:improved duplicity|cleri.name: Improved Duplicity
subclassfeature:improved duplicity|cleri.subtitle: Cleric (Ambition Domain (PSA)) 17
entries: At 17th level, you can create up to four duplicates of yourself, instead of one, when you use Invoke Duplicity. As a bonus action on your turn, you can move any number of them up to 30 feet, to a maximum range of 120 feet.

subclassfeature:improved duplicity|cleri.name: Improved Duplicity
subclassfeature:improved duplicity|cleri.subtitle: Cleric (Trickery Domain) 17
entries: The illusion of your Invoke Duplicity has grown more powerful in the following ways.

entries.name: Shared Distraction
entries: When you and your allies make attack rolls against a creature within 5 feet of the illusion, the attack rolls have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}.

entries.name: Healing Illusion
entries: When the illusion ends, you or a creature of your choice within 5 feet of it regains a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your Cleric level.

subclassfeature:improved illusions|wizar.name: Improved Illusions
subclassfeature:improved illusions|wizar.subtitle: Wizard (Illusionist) 3
entries: You can cast Illusion spells without providing Verbal components, and if an Illusion spell you cast has a range of 10+ feet, the range increases by 60 feet.

You also know the {@spell Minor Illusion|XPHB} cantrip. If you already know it, you learn a different Wizard cantrip of your choice. The cantrip doesn't count against your number of cantrips known. You can create both a sound and an image with a single casting of {@spell Minor Illusion|XPHB}, and you can cast it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

subclassfeature:improved mystic fighting.name: Improved Mystic Fighting Style
subclassfeature:improved mystic fighting.subtitle: Monk (Warrior of the Mystic Arts) 17
entries: When you use Flurry of Blows, you can replace two of the {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes} with a casting of one of your level 1 or 2 Sorcerer spells that has a casting time of an action, and you cast it as part of the same {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} you use to activate Flurry of Blows.

subclassfeature:improved reanimation|art.name: Improved Reanimation
subclassfeature:improved reanimation|art.subtitle: Artificer (Reanimator) 9
entries: The damage of your {@creature Reanimated Companion|RHW|Reanimated Companion's} Death Burst increases to {@damage 4d4}. Necrotic damage dealt by your companion ignores {@spell Resistance|XPHB}.

subclassfeature:improved reaper|cleric|d.name: Improved Reaper
subclassfeature:improved reaper|cleric|d.subtitle: Cleric (Death Domain) 17
entries: Starting at 17th level, when the cleric casts a Necromancy spell of 1st through 5th-level that targets only one creature, the spell can instead target two creatures within range and within 5 feet of each other. If the spell consumes its material components, the cleric must provide them for each target.

subclassfeature:improved shadow step|mon.name: Improved Shadow Step
subclassfeature:improved shadow step|mon.subtitle: Monk (Warrior of Shadow) 11
entries: You can draw on your Shadowfell connection to empower your teleportation. When you use your Shadow Step, you can expend 1 Focus Point to remove the requirement that you must start and end in {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} or {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB} for that use of the feature. As part of this {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can make an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} immediately after you teleport.

subclassfeature:improved war magic|fight.name: Improved War Magic
subclassfeature:improved war magic|fight.subtitle: Fighter (Eldritch Knight) 18
entries: When you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action on your turn, you can replace two of the attacks with a casting of one of your level 1 or level 2 Wizard spells that has a casting time of an action.

subclassfeature:improved warding flare|c.name: Improved Warding Flare
subclassfeature:improved warding flare|c.subtitle: Cleric (Light Domain) 6
entries: You regain all expended uses of your Warding Flare when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
In addition, whenever you use Warding Flare, you can give the target of the triggering attack a number of {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to {@dice 2d6} plus your Wisdom modifier.

subclassfeature:indestructible life|warl.name: Indestructible Life
subclassfeature:indestructible life|warl.subtitle: Warlock (The Undying) 14
entries: When you reach 14th level, you partake some of the true secrets of the Undying. On your turn, you can use a bonus action to regain hit points equal to {@dice 1d8} + your warlock level. Additionally, if you put a severed body part of yours back in place when you use this feature, the part reattaches.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

subclassfeature:indomitable teleport|fig.name: Indomitable Teleport
subclassfeature:indomitable teleport|fig.subtitle: Fighter (Arcane Archer) 15
entries: Your magical mastery lets you escape dire situations. When you use your Indomitable feature and succeed on the saving throw, you can teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

subclassfeature:inescapable destruction|.name: Inescapable Destruction
subclassfeature:inescapable destruction|.subtitle: Cleric (Death Domain) 6
entries: Starting at 6th level, the cleric's ability to channel negative energy becomes more potent. Necrotic damage dealt by the character's cleric spells and Channel Divinity options ignores resistance to necrotic damage.

subclassfeature:infectious fury|barbaria.name: Infectious Fury
subclassfeature:infectious fury|barbaria.subtitle: Barbarian (Path of the Beast) 10
entries: {@i 10th-level Path of the Beast feature}

When you hit a creature with your natural weapons while you are raging, the beast within you can curse your target with rabid fury. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC equal to 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus) or suffer one of the following effects (your choice):

items: The target must use its reaction to make a melee attack against another creature of your choice that you can see.
The target takes {@damage 2d12} psychic damage.

entries: You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

subclassfeature:infectious inspiration|b.name: Infectious Inspiration
subclassfeature:infectious inspiration|b.subtitle: Bard (College of Eloquence) 14
entries: {@i 14th-level College of Eloquence feature}

When you successfully inspire someone, the power of your eloquence can now spread to someone else. When a creature within 60 feet of you adds one of your Bardic Inspiration dice to its ability check, attack roll, or saving throw and the roll succeeds, you can use your reaction to encourage a different creature (other than yourself) that can hear you within 60 feet of you, giving it a Bardic Inspiration die without expending any of your Bardic Inspiration uses.
You can use this reaction a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

subclassfeature:infiltration expertise|r.name: Infiltration Expertise
subclassfeature:infiltration expertise|r.subtitle: Rogue (Assassin) 9
entries: You are expert at the following techniques that aid your infiltrations.

entries.name: Masterful Mimicry
entries: You can unerringly mimic another person's speech, handwriting, or both if you have spent at least 1 hour studying them.

entries.name: Roving Aim
entries: Your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} isn't reduced to 0 by using Steady Aim.

subclassfeature:infiltrator|artificer|ar.name: Infiltrator
subclassfeature:infiltrator|artificer|ar.subtitle: Artificer (Armorer) 3
entries: You customize your armor for subtler undertakings. It has the following features:

items.name: Lightning Launcher
entries: A gemlike node appears on your armor, from which you can shoot bolts of lightning. The launcher counts as a Simple Ranged weapon with a normal range of 90 feet and a long range of 300 feet, and it deals {@damage 1d6} Lightning damage on a hit. Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with the launcher, you can deal an extra {@damage 1d6} Lightning damage to that target.

items.name: Powered Steps
entries: Your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 5 feet.

items.name: Dampening Field
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks. If the armor imposes {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on such checks, the {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} and {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} cancel each other, as normal.

subclassfeature:ingenious movement|artif.name: Ingenious Movement
subclassfeature:ingenious movement|artif.subtitle: Artificer (Cartographer) 9
entries: When you use your {@classFeature Flash of Genius|Artificer|EFA|7|EFA}, you or a willing creature of your choice that you can see within 30 feet of yourself can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see as part of that same {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}.

subclassfeature:inquisitive|rogue|inquis.name: Inquisitive
subclassfeature:inquisitive|rogue|inquis.subtitle: Rogue (Inquisitive) 3
entries: As an archetypal Inquisitive, you excel at rooting out secrets and unraveling mysteries. You rely on your sharp eye for detail, but also on your finely honed ability to read the words and deeds of other creatures to determine their true intent. You excel at defeating creatures that hide among and prey upon ordinary folk, and your mastery of lore and your keen deductions make you well equipped to expose and end hidden evils.

subclassfeature:insightful fighting|rogu.name: Insightful Fighting
subclassfeature:insightful fighting|rogu.subtitle: Rogue (Inquisitive) 3
entries: At 3rd level, you gain the ability to decipher an opponent's tactics and develop a counter to them. As a bonus action, you can make a Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check against a creature you can see that isn't {@condition incapacitated}, contested by the target's Charisma ({@skill Deception}) check. If you succeed, you can use your Sneak Attack against that target even if you don't have advantage on the attack roll, but not if you have disadvantage on it.
This benefit lasts for 1 minute or until you successfully use this feature against a different target.

subclassfeature:insightful manipulator|r.name: Insightful Manipulator
subclassfeature:insightful manipulator|r.subtitle: Rogue (Mastermind) 9
entries: Starting at 9th level, if you spend at least 1 minute observing or interacting with another creature outside combat, you can learn certain information about its capabilities compared to your own. The DM tells you if the creature is your equal, superior, or inferior in regard to two of the following characteristics of your choice:

items: Intelligence score
Wisdom score
Charisma score
Class levels (if any)

entries: At the DM's option, you might also realize you know a piece of the creature's history or one of its personality traits, if it has any.

subclassfeature:inspiring commander|figh.name: Inspiring Commander
subclassfeature:inspiring commander|figh.subtitle: Fighter (Banneret) 18
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Bolstered Rally
entries: The area of effect for both Group Recovery and Rallying Surge is now a 60-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}.

entries.name: Unshakable Bravery
entries: You have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} and {@condition Frightened|XPHB} conditions.

subclassfeature:inspiring movement|bard|.name: Inspiring Movement
subclassfeature:inspiring movement|bard|.subtitle: Bard (College of Dance) 6
entries: When an enemy you can see ends its turn within 5 feet of you, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} and expend one use of your Bardic Inspiration to move up to half your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}. Then one ally of your choice within 30 feet of you can also move up to half their {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} using their {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}.
None of this feature's movement provokes {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}.

subclassfeature:inspiring smite|paladin|.name: Inspiring Smite
subclassfeature:inspiring smite|paladin|.subtitle: Paladin (Oath of Glory) 3
entries: Immediately after you cast {@spell Divine Smite|XPHB}, you can expend one use of your Channel Divinity and distribute {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} to creatures of your choice within 30 feet of yourself, which can include you. The total number of {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equals {@dice 2d8} plus your Paladin level, divided among the chosen creatures however you like.

subclassfeature:instinctive charm|wizard.name: Instinctive Charm
subclassfeature:instinctive charm|wizard.subtitle: Wizard (Enchanter) 10
entries: When a creature within 30 feet of you that you can see hits you with an attack roll, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to force the attacker to make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, the attack misses instead, and if there is another creature within range of the attack other than the attacker, the attacker targets that creature with the triggering attack, using the same attack roll. If multiple creatures are within the attack's range, you choose which one to target.

Once you take this {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also restore your use of it by casting an {@filter Enchantment spell|spells|school=E} with a spell slot.

subclassfeature:intimidating presence|ba.name: Intimidating Presence
subclassfeature:intimidating presence|ba.subtitle: Barbarian (Path of the Berserker) 14
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can strike terror into others with your menacing presence and primal power. When you do so, each creature of your choice in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you must make a Wisdom saving throw ({@dc 8} plus your Strength modifier and {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}). On a failed save, a creature has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. At the end of each of the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} creature's turns, the creature repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} unless you expend a use of your Rage (no action required) to restore your use of it.

subclassfeature:invincible conqueror|pal.name: Invincible Conqueror
subclassfeature:invincible conqueror|pal.subtitle: Paladin (Oath of Conquest) 20
entries: At 20th level, you gain the ability to harness extraordinary martial prowess. As an action, you can magically become an avatar of conquest, gaining the following benefits for 1 minute:

items: You have resistance to all damage.
When you take the {@action Attack} action on your turn, you can make one additional attack as part of that action.
Your melee weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20 on the {@dice d20}.

entries: Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

subclassfeature:invoke duplicity|cleric|.name: Invoke Duplicity
subclassfeature:invoke duplicity|cleric|.subtitle: Cleric (Trickery Domain) 3
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend one use of your Channel Divinity to create a perfect visual illusion of yourself in an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet of yourself. The illusion is intangible and doesn't occupy its space. It lasts for 1 minute, but it ends early if you dismiss it (no action required) or have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition. The illusion is animated and mimics your expressions and gestures. While it persists, you gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Cast Spells
entries: You can cast spells as though you were in the illusion's space, but you must use your own senses.

entries.name: Distract
entries: When both you and your illusion are within 5 feet of a creature that can see the illusion, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against that creature, given how distracting the illusion is to the target.

entries.name: Move
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can move the illusion up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see that is within 120 feet of yourself.

subclassfeature:iron mind|ranger|gloom s.name: Iron Mind
subclassfeature:iron mind|ranger|gloom s.subtitle: Ranger (Gloom Stalker) 7
entries: You have honed your ability to resist mind-altering powers. You gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws. If you already have this proficiency, you instead gain proficiency in Intelligence or Charisma saving throws (your choice).

subclassfeature:kensei's shot|monk|kense.name: Kensei's Shot
subclassfeature:kensei's shot|monk|kense.subtitle: Monk (Way of the Kensei) 3
entries: You can use a bonus action on your turn to make your ranged attacks with a kensei weapon more deadly. When you do so, any target you hit with a ranged attack using a kensei weapon takes an extra {@damage 1d4} damage of the weapon's type. You retain this benefit until the end of the current turn.

subclassfeature:knightly envoy|fighter|b.name: Knightly Envoy
subclassfeature:knightly envoy|fighter|b.subtitle: Fighter (Banneret) 3
entries: You know how to conduct yourself with grace as a noble ambassador. You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Comprehension
entries: You can cast the {@spell Comprehend Languages|XPHB} spell but only as a {@variantrule Ritual|XPHB}. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it.

entries.name: Polyglot
entries: You learn one language from the language tables in the Player's Handbook or chapter 2 of this book. When you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can replace a language learned from this benefit with another language you have heard, seen signed, or read in the past 24 hours.

entries.name: Well Spoken
entries: You gain proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: {@skill Insight|XPHB}, {@skill Intimidation|XPHB}, {@skill Persuasion|XPHB}, or {@skill Performance|XPHB}.

subclassfeature:know your enemy|fighter|.name: Know Your Enemy
subclassfeature:know your enemy|fighter|.subtitle: Fighter (Battle Master) 7
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can discern certain strengths and weaknesses of a creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself; you know whether that creature has any Immunities, Resistances, or Vulnerabilities, and if the creature has any, you know what they are.
Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also restore a use of the feature by expending one Superiority Die (no action required).

subclassfeature:knowledge domain|cleric|.name: Knowledge Domain
subclassfeature:knowledge domain|cleric|.subtitle: Cleric (Knowledge Domain (PSA)) 1
entries: The gods of knowledge—including {@deity Oghma}, {@deity Boccob|Greyhawk}, {@deity Gilean|Dragonlance}, {@deity Aureon|Eberron}, and {@deity Thoth|Egyptian}—value learning and understanding above all. Some teach that knowledge is to be gathered and shared in libraries and universities, or promote the practical knowledge of craft and invention. Some deities hoard knowledge and keep its secrets to themselves. And some promise their followers that they will gain tremendous power if they unlock the secrets of the multiverse. Followers of these gods study esoteric lore, collect old tomes, delve into the secret places of the earth, and learn all they can. Some gods of knowledge promote the practical knowledge of craft and invention, including smith deities like {@deity Gond}, {@deity Reorx|Dragonlance}, {@deity Onatar|Eberron}, {@deity Moradin|Nonhuman}, {@deity Hephaestus|Greek}, and {@deity Goibhniu|Celtic}.
At each indicated cleric level, you add the listed spells to your spells prepared.

subclassfeature:knowledge domain|cleric|.name: Knowledge Domain
subclassfeature:knowledge domain|cleric|.subtitle: Cleric (Knowledge Domain) 3
entries: {@i Unearth Secrets and Master the Mind}

The Knowledge Domain values learning and understanding above all. Clerics who tap into this domain study esoteric lore, collect old tomes, delve into secret places, and examine the processes of the mind. To them, knowledge is more valuable than material wealth, and learning is an act of worship. Libraries, universities, and other educational institutions also draw on the power of the Knowledge Domain.

Gods of knowledge vary from masters of arcane magic to patrons of craft and invention. In Faerûn, Clerics of the Knowledge Domain worship deities of learning and ingenuity such as {@deity Oghma|Faerûnian|FRHoF} and {@deity Gond|Faerûnian|FRHoF}, among many others.

subclassfeature:knowledge domain|cleric|.name: Knowledge Domain
subclassfeature:knowledge domain|cleric|.subtitle: Cleric (Knowledge Domain (PSA)) 3
entries: The gods of knowledge—including {@deity Oghma}, {@deity Boccob|Greyhawk}, {@deity Gilean|Dragonlance}, {@deity Aureon|Eberron}, and {@deity Thoth|Egyptian}—value learning and understanding above all. Some teach that knowledge is to be gathered and shared in libraries and universities, or promote the practical knowledge of craft and invention. Some deities hoard knowledge and keep its secrets to themselves. And some promise their followers that they will gain tremendous power if they unlock the secrets of the multiverse. Followers of these gods study esoteric lore, collect old tomes, delve into the secret places of the earth, and learn all they can. Some gods of knowledge promote the practical knowledge of craft and invention, including smith deities like {@deity Gond}, {@deity Reorx|Dragonlance}, {@deity Onatar|Eberron}, {@deity Moradin|Nonhuman}, {@deity Hephaestus|Greek}, and {@deity Goibhniu|Celtic}.
At each indicated cleric level, you add the listed spells to your spells prepared.

subclassfeature:knowledge domain (psa)|c.name: Knowledge Domain (PSA)
subclassfeature:knowledge domain (psa)|c.subtitle: Cleric (Knowledge Domain (PSA)) 3

entries: The worthy shall cultivate a nimble mind that can perceive the wonders beyond imagination that wait in the afterlife.

Kefnet's task is to pass on this teaching of the God-Pharaoh and elucidate its meaning. He teaches that the afterlife will be inhabited only by those who have proved by their wits that they are worthy of dwelling in the glorious presence of the God-Pharaoh. He trains acolytes and initiates to push their limits and challenge their mental capacity with spells of ever-greater power.
