subclassfeature:wind speaker|sorcerer|st.subtitle: Sorcerer (Storm Sorcery) 1
entries: The arcane magic you command is infused with elemental air. You can speak, read, and write {@language Primordial}. Knowing this language allows you to understand and be understood by those who speak its dialects: {@language Primordial||Aquan}, {@language Primordial||Auran}, {@language Primordial||Ignan}, and {@language Primordial||Terran}.

subclassfeature:wings unfurled|monk|asce.name: Wings Unfurled
subclassfeature:wings unfurled|monk|asce.subtitle: Monk (Way of the Ascendant Dragon) 6
entries: {@i 6th-level Way of the Ascendant Dragon feature}

When you use your Step of the Wind, you can unfurl spectral draconic wings from your back that vanish at the end of your turn. While the wings exist, you have a flying speed equal to your walking speed.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

subclassfeature:winter walker|ranger|win.name: Winter Walker
subclassfeature:winter walker|ranger|win.subtitle: Ranger (Winter Walker) 3
entries: {@i Withstand the Horrors of Frigid Wastelands}

Winter Walkers hone their craft in the bleak and frozen wilds of places like Icewind Dale. These ruthless, rimed Rangers hunt monsters that haunt arctic wastelands, eventually becoming frigid terrors themselves. Winter Walkers are well versed in the phenomena of Icewind Dale, including the latent magic of fallen Netherese cities, endemic monsters like {@creature yeti|XMM|yetis} and {@creature crag cat|SKT|crag cats}, and the rising threat of Underdark invaders. Due to their cold pragmatism, terrifying magic, and mastery of the region, Winter Walkers are regarded with equal parts respect and fear. Ten-Towns citizens say that Winter Walkers' frequent exposure to malignant entities gives them their fearsome powers. Many Reghed nomads, on the other hand, believe that nature spirits bestow on Winter Walkers a unique curse.

subclassfeature:winter walker spells|ran.name: Winter Walker Spells
subclassfeature:winter walker spells|ran.subtitle: Ranger (Winter Walker) 3
entries: When you reach a Ranger level specified in the Winter Walker Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

subclassfeature:wizardly quill|wizard|sc.name: Wizardly Quill
subclassfeature:wizardly quill|wizard|sc.subtitle: Wizard (Order of Scribes) 2
entries: {@i 2nd-level Order of Scribes feature}
As a bonus action, you can magically create a Tiny quill in your free hand. The magic quill has the following properties:

items: The quill doesn't require ink. When you write with it, it produces ink in a color of your choice on the writing surface.
The time you must spend to copy a spell into your spellbook equals 2 minutes per spell level if you use the quill for the transcription.
You can erase anything you write with the quill if you wave the feather over the text as a bonus action, provided the text is within 5 feet of you.

entries: This quill disappears if you create another one or if you die.

subclassfeature:wondrous alteration|wiza.name: Wondrous Alteration
subclassfeature:wondrous alteration|wiza.subtitle: Wizard (Transmuter) 3
entries: You always have the {@spell Alter Self|XPHB} spell prepared and can cast it once without expending a spell slot. You regain the ability to cast it in this way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
While under the effects of {@spell Alter Self|XPHB}, you gain an additional benefit for each of its options.

entries.name: Aquatic Adaptation
entries: While underwater, you can take the {@action Dash|XPHB} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

entries.name: Change Appearance
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Charisma ({@skill Deception|XPHB}) checks.

entries.name: Natural Weapons
entries: The damage of your new growth increases to {@damage 2d6} damage of the type associated with the growth. You also have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Constitution saving throws to maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB}.

subclassfeature:words of terror|bard|whi.name: Words of Terror
subclassfeature:words of terror|bard|whi.subtitle: Bard (College of Whispers) 3
entries: At 3rd level, you learn to infuse innocent-seeming words with an insidious magic that can inspire terror.

If you speak to a humanoid alone for at least 1 minute, you can attempt to seed paranoia in its mind. At the end of the conversation, the target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or be {@condition frightened} of you or another creature of your choice. The target is {@condition frightened} in this way for 1 hour, until it is attacked or damaged, or until it witnesses its allies being attacked or damaged.
If the target succeeds on its saving throw, the target has no hint that you tried to frighten it.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

subclassfeature:wrath of the sea|druid|s.name: Wrath of the Sea
subclassfeature:wrath of the sea|druid|s.subtitle: Druid (Circle of the Sea) 3
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend a use of your Wild Shape to manifest a 5-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} that takes the form of ocean spray that surrounds you for 10 minutes. It ends early if you dismiss it (no action required), manifest it again, or have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

When you manifest the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} and as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on your subsequent turns, you can choose another creature you can see in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC or take Cold damage and, if the creature is Large or smaller, be pushed up to 15 feet away from you. To determine this damage, roll a number of d6s equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of one die).

subclassfeature:wrath of the storm|cleri.name: Wrath of the Storm
subclassfeature:wrath of the storm|cleri.subtitle: Cleric (Tempest Domain) 1
entries: Also at 1st level, you can thunderously rebuke attackers. When a creature within 5 feet of you that you can see hits you with an attack, you can use your reaction to cause the creature to make a Dexterity saving throw. The creature takes {@damage 2d8} lightning or thunder damage (your choice) on a failed saving throw, and half as much damage on a successful one.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (a minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

subclassfeature:wrath of the wild|ranger.name: Wrath of the Wild
subclassfeature:wrath of the wild|ranger.subtitle: Ranger (Hollow Warden) 3
entries: You draw power from the strange and ancient horrors of the land, causing you to sprout unnatural growths, such as bloody antlers or putrid fangs, or causing your shadow to lengthen or twist around you. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend a use of {@classFeature Favored Enemy|Ranger|XPHB|1} to transform into a ghastly form, gaining the following benefits for 1 minute or until you have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition, die, or end the transformation (no action required).

entries.name: Ancient Armor
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to AC, as your body is wreathed in rotten bark and beastly bristles. This bonus increases to +2 when you reach Ranger level 11.

entries.name: Prowling Retribution
entries: Immediately after a creature you can see within 5 feet of yourself deals damage to you or one of your allies, you can make an {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} against that creature.

entries.name: Unnerving Aura
entries: When you transform and at the start of each of your subsequent turns, each creature of your choice in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you makes a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, a creature has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the start of your next turn.

subclassfeature:writhing tide|ranger|swa.name: Writhing Tide
subclassfeature:writhing tide|ranger|swa.subtitle: Ranger (Swarmkeeper) 7
entries: {@i 7th-level Swarmkeeper feature}

You can condense part of your swarm into a focused mass that lifts you up. As a bonus action, you gain a flying speed of 10 feet and can hover. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until you are {@condition incapacitated}.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

subclassfeature:zeal domain (psa)|cleric.name: Zeal Domain (PSA)
subclassfeature:zeal domain (psa)|cleric.subtitle: Cleric (Zeal Domain (PSA)) 1

entries: The worthy shall rush to the God-Pharaoh's side with relentless zeal, rising to overcome every obstacle in their way.

The God-Pharaoh expects those he welcomes into the afterlife to desire it above all other pleasures and achievements, and for them to show their dedication, passion, and fervor through their actions. Hazoret is charged with cultivating this zeal in the initiates who come under her care, and she has undertaken the task with appropriate enthusiasm. She recognizes, however, that the best way to teach zeal is by demonstrating it.
At each indicated cleric level, add the listed spells to your spells prepared.

entries.caption: Zeal Domain Spells
rows: {@spell fire shield||fire shield (warm shield only)}, {@spell freedom of movement}

subclassfeature:zeal domain (psa)|cleric.name: Zeal Domain (PSA)
subclassfeature:zeal domain (psa)|cleric.subtitle: Cleric (Zeal Domain (PSA)) 3

entries: The worthy shall rush to the God-Pharaoh's side with relentless zeal, rising to overcome every obstacle in their way.

The God-Pharaoh expects those he welcomes into the afterlife to desire it above all other pleasures and achievements, and for them to show their dedication, passion, and fervor through their actions. Hazoret is charged with cultivating this zeal in the initiates who come under her care, and she has undertaken the task with appropriate enthusiasm. She recognizes, however, that the best way to teach zeal is by demonstrating it.
At each indicated cleric level, add the listed spells to your spells prepared.

entries.caption: Zeal Domain Spells
rows: {@spell fire shield||fire shield (warm shield only)}, {@spell freedom of movement}

subclassfeature:zealous presence|barbari.name: Zealous Presence
subclassfeature:zealous presence|barbari.subtitle: Barbarian (Path of the Zealot) 10
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you unleash a battle cry infused with divine energy. Up to ten other creatures of your choice within 60 feet of you gain {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls and saving throws until the start of your next turn.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} unless you expend a use of your Rage (no action required) to restore your use of it.
